newsitem.title: DUBAI: Yemen Jannah oilfield to be commissioned in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Yemen Jannah oilfield to be commissioned in Oct.

text.p: The Jannah block five oilfield in Yemen is scheduled to be commissioned in the first half of October, a Yemeni oil official said on Wednesday.
Output will be linked to the U.S. Hunt-Exxon operated Marib pipeline system which supplies crude to the Ras Isa export terminal on the Red Sea.
"Early October. This is the intention so far," the official said, referring to start-up of the block.
The official could not provide production forecasts but industry sources in Yemen expect output to reach 15,000 bpd early next year, rising to 70,000 bpd.
Marib production has recently been running at 170,000 bpd, just under half of Yemen's total oil production.
